title: Paired spatial evolution, 365 days: adaptive switch vs MTD
notes: every frame is the engine's validated end-of-day spatial state; frame aggregates are checked against the run's own burden arrays before export
the resistant-fraction divergence between the arms IS the treatment-resistance story: same tumour, same seed, different dosing policy
artifact carries the frame schedule it was built with; raising the density budget re-renders more frames, never different physics

data.model: EvoSteer paired spatial evolution: adaptive collateral switch vs MTD

policy.pfs_note: progression not reached inside the horizon

notes: frames are the engine's exact end-of-day spatial state on the recorded days; the timeline slider indexes frame_days, not every calendar day
each frame is a complete .vti (drug_A, drug_B, sensitive, resistant, tissue/diffusion maps) -- open any one of them standalone in ParaView
the two arms share geometry and seed (paired design); the only difference is the dosing policy

the resistant fraction is reported as 0.0 below the ~1e8-cell detection floor: R/(S+R) reaches 1.0 as soon as the sensitive population is extinct, so for a sub-detectable lesion the ratio describes nothing. Read the absolute burden arrays on those days
resistance here is SELECTION of the subclone present at diagnosis, not newly evolved mutation: at the calibrated mutation rate (5e-5) turning mutation off entirely does not change the outcome
simulation on a real segmentation, NOT a patient prediction
data.r0_source: TCGA-GBM bulk RNA-seq mesial-signature z=-0.59 -> r0=0.0050 via calibrated band [0.005, 0.3] (GDC open-access TCGA-GBM RNA-seq STAR gene expression quantification (TPM, GENCODE v36); api.gdc.cancer.gov, files access=open)
data.geometry_note: BraTS-2021 case 01017 expert segmentation (engine-decimated), the same geometry as the 365-Day Outcome cards and the ParaView gallery
